question: Recently The Indian Government has proposed to levy a "Green tax" on the vehicles older than _________ years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Indian Government has introduced a "Green tax" to promote cleaner and more environmentally friendly vehicles.
 
• This tax is levied on older vehicles to discourage their use and encourage owners to switch to newer, less polluting models.
